leases.focus: ONE-SHOT TEAM V2 ACCEPTANCE AFTER TARGETED CONTROL-PLANE REPAIRS. Prove the complete governed chain Admission -> Reservation -> Worker -> Branch Preservation -> Independent QC -> Persisted QC -> Integration -> Target Promotion -> Memory Closure in one fresh non-duplicate wave. Audit only: no product implementation, no Architecture Freeze V4/V4.1 changes, no accepted F1-F6/CCC/UX reopening, no edits outside this lease evidence root. The audit must specifically verify: QC workspace executes on the happy path; persisted QC uses measured actual-change evidence (patch SHA, patch bytes, changed-file count); Integrator fails closed on missing/negative QC and permits promotion only after persisted QC PASS; legacy continuous auto-dispatch remains disabled; no duplicate worker is spawned; target promotion and registry closure are evidence-linked.
leases.purpose: Final decisive Team V2 end-to-end acceptance after the two reproduced QC control defects were repaired.
leases.value: Decides whether Team V2 is reliable enough to continue product construction.
